steps.title: Inspect NoteKeep Project Layout
steps.description: Review the existing user interface hierarchy in activity_main.xml to design a layout-based launch splash animation layer.

steps.title: Implement Splash Screen Overlay UI
steps.description: Add layout_splash to activity_main.xml containing a stylish background, application icon, app title, description, and an active progress spinner.

steps.title: Configure Animations in MainActivity
steps.description: Create entrance scale transitions for the logo icon and title to simulate a dynamic startup sequence.

steps.title: Integrate Automatic Transition Handler
steps.description: Use a post-delayed handler to seamlessly fade out the splash loading screen and bring the dashboard into focus after loading.

steps.title: Perform Java 8 Compatibility Review
steps.description: Verify that all animation listeners and handler runnables use standard anonymous classes to preserve build pipeline standards.

steps.title: Building NoteKeep
steps.description: Assemble NoteKeep to package the new high-performance, animated opening transition experience.
